title: Overcomplicated redesign is ruining a once-simple app
text:
As a long-time Upstox user, I am extremely disappointed with the direction this app is heading. I am not a daily day trader; I simply invest manage my portfolio, invest, and close the app until the next time. Upstox used to be great for this, but the recent design changes have turned a once-clean platform into a cluttered mess.
In the name of "upgrading," they have made basic navigation unnecessarily complicated. Finding standard services and essential portfolio details takes way too much effort now. The home page is crowded with irrelevant features that many of us never asked for:
 Unsolicited F&O & Strategy Tools: Pushing complex options trading strategies and trade ideas directly onto the homepage clutter is useless for long-term investors. Anyone who actively trades F&O already knows what tools they need; forcing it on everyone else just creates noise.
 Intrusive "Expert Advice" & Mutual Fund SIPs: Putting aggressive recommendations front and center makes the app feel cheap and chaotic. If someone wants to start a Mutual Fund SIP, they will intentionally navigate to the MF section—it doesn't need to take over the main screen.
Upstox needs to realize that adding more clutter isn't an upgrade—it's bad UX. Making the app hard to understand for simple, long-term investors will only drive customers away. If this bloated interface continues to prioritize pushed features over clean usability, I will consider closing my Demat account and shifting my portfolio to a simpler competitor.

title: Complaint Regarding Slow App Performance, Real-Time Data Delay and High Charges
text:
I am an active Upstox customer and would like to register a formal complaint regarding the poor performance of the Upstox trading platform.

The issues I am facing are:

1. The Upstox app loads very slowly, especially during market hours.
2. Real-time market data is not updating properly. Data freezes frequently and updates only after several seconds or sometimes minutes.
3. Charts and watchlists stop syncing regularly, making trading decisions difficult.
4. Order execution and price updates appear delayed compared to other broker platforms.
5. The platform performance becomes unreliable during volatile market conditions.
6. I also find the charges and fees comparatively high considering the quality of service being provided.

Due to these technical issues, I am unable to monitor the market accurately and there is a risk of financial loss. A trading platform must provide stable and real-time data without interruption.

title: From Upstox to Upstops
text:
I’ve been a user for the last 2 years, and the app has always been smooth and reliable. However, after the latest update, the overall experience has noticeably declined.

The new UI looks modern and clean, but performance has taken a hit. Navigation has become much slower than before, and portfolio values don’t refresh as quickly as they used to, which is frustrating during live market hours.

Opening charts now takes longer, affecting quick analysis and trading decisions. Another major issue is app continuity—when I minimize the app and reopen it, it rarely resumes where I left off. Instead, I often have to force close it from the background and launch it again, which becomes very inconvenient.

The redesign is visually appealing, but I hope the team prioritizes performance and stability in the next update. A fast and responsive experience is much more important for a trading app than cosmetic improvements.

I’ve been using Upstox for trading and overall it’s a decent platform with low brokerage and a clean interface. It’s beginner-friendly and charts are useful.

However, there are some serious issues during live trading. The app often lags or reconnects during high volatility, especially on expiry days. I also faced order execution problems where the wrong order type (GTT instead of intraday) got placed, causing losses.

If Upstox improves stability and execution speed, it can become one of the best apps. Right now, it’s good for learning but risky for fast intraday and options trading.

title: Request to Improve App Accessibility and User-Friendliness for Visually Impaired Users
text:
I hope you are doing well. I am writing to share some important feedback regarding the recent updates to your mobile app.  

The new version of the Upstox app seems to have become less user-friendly, especially for visually impaired users. The earlier version of the app was clean, simple, and much easier to navigate. It allowed users like me to easily access stock information, invest, and manage portfolios independently.  

However, after the new update, the interface has become more complex and less accessible. For visually impaired users who rely on screen readers and accessibility features, navigating between sections of the app has become challenging. This makes it difficult to invest or even perform basic actions smoothly.  

I sincerely request the Upstox team to take this feedback seriously and work towards improving accessibility and usability in the app. Making the platform more inclusive will not only help differently-abled users continue using your services confidently but will also reflect the company’s commitment to accessibility and equal opportunity for all investors.  

Additionally, I would also like to highlight that the broker charges seem higher when placing trades through assisted modes, which further limits the independence of visually impaired investors. I kindly urge the team to consider making these aspects more inclusive and affordable.  

Thank you for taking the time to read this message. I truly believe that Upstox can lead by example by ensuring its platform remains accessible, inclusive, and easy to use for everyone.

title: Serious Bug and Poor Customer Support
text:
I had a very disappointing experience with the Upstox app. I had placed a GTT (Good Till Triggered) order in the F&O segment, which was executed, but the platform still showed it as an active trade. This glitch prevented me from selling the position, ultimately causing a significant financial loss.

Worse, I reached out multiple times to customer support via email and received no response. When you’re dealing with real money in the market, such bugs and unresponsive support are unacceptable.

This kind of technical failure and lack of accountability is not just frustrating—it’s dangerous. I would caution other traders to be very careful when relying on Upstox for F&O trades.
